blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: End-to-end video quality assessment (VQA) methods leave the regional evidence underlying their predictions largely implicit. We introduce an explicit pixel-level regional representation for VQA, instantiated as a Quality-Relevance Heatmap (QRH) that combines localized degradation evidence with perceptual priors under vision-language model guidance, without requiring pixel-level annotations. We apply QRH to existing VQA models through two deterministic fragment-sampling strategies: distribution-preserving sampling approximates the original sampler's QRH-score distribution without retraining, while quality-aware sampling prioritizes regions with high QRH scores and is paired with fine-tuning. Experiments with DOVER on multiple benchmarks show that the former closely approximates predictions averaged over random samples, while the latter improves most evaluated metrics across popular VQA benchmarks. These results support explicit regional representations as a useful interface for downstream VQA.
blocks.zh: 端到端视频质量评估(VQA)方法使得区域证据在很大程度上隐含在预测中. 我们为VQA引入一个明确的像素级区域代表,即时作为质量-相干热(QRH),将局部降解证据和感知前兆结合到视觉语言模型指导下,而不需要像素级说明. 我们通过两种确定性碎片抽样策略,将QRH应用于现有的VQA模型:分布-保留采样近似于原始采样者的QRH分数分配而不进行再培训,而有质量意识的采样则优先考虑QRH分数高并有微调配对的区域. 与DOVER关于多个基准的实验表明,前者与随机样本的预测平均值非常相近,而后者则改进了大多数评价的衡量尺度,跨越了流行的VQA基准. 这些结果支持明确区域代表作为下游《自愿质量协定》的有用界面。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
No-reference video quality assessment (NR-VQA) predicts perceptual quality
without a pristine reference. Recent methods achieve strong performance
through learned representations [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] ,
yet the regional evidence underlying their predictions remains largely
implicit. This raises a central question: What regional evidence
is relevant to perceptual quality judgments, and how should it be represented?

annotators consider both localized degradation, such as blur, compression
artifacts, and temporal instability, and the perceptual importance of the
affected regions.

blocks.en: We therefore introduce an explicit pixel-level regional representation for VQA, instantiated as a Quality-Relevance Heatmap (QRH). QRH combines localized quality evidence with perceptual priors under vision-language model (VLM) guidance, without requiring pixel-level quality annotations. Here, quality relevance refers to the estimated importance of localized visual evidence to quality assessment, rather than a decomposition of subjective video quality into regional contributions. QRH separates two complementary aspects of regional quality analysis: quality evidence captures localized appearance degradation, temporal inconsistency, and compression artifacts, while perceptual priors characterize where such evidence are more perceptually important through motion vulnerability and visual saliency. Their composition produces an explicit pixel-level representation that summarizes the spatial distribution of quality-relevant evidence and its perceptual importance.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们为VQA引入了明确的像素级区域代表,即时作为质量-相关性热(QRH). QRH在视觉语言模型(VLM)指导下将本地化的质量证据与感知前兆结合,而不需要像素级的质量说明. 这里,质量相关性是指局部视觉证据对质量评估的估计重要性,而不是将主观视频质量分解为区域贡献. QRH将区域质量分析的两个互补方面区分开来:质量证据捕捉局部外观退化,时间不一致,压缩文物,而知觉前传则通过运动脆弱性和视觉优势来描述这些证据在观念上更为重要的领域. 其构成产生一个明确的像素级代表,总结了质量相关证据的空间分布及其感知重要性.

blocks.en: Beyond representation, we demonstrate the utility of QRH through two deterministic fragment-sampling strategies for existing VQA models. Distribution-preserving sampling (DPS) approximates the original random sampler’s QRH-score distribution without retraining, while quality-aware sampling (QAS) prioritizes regions with high QRH scores and is paired with fine-tuning. These strategies allow QRH to guide regional selection while preserving the original fragment layout and VQA architecture.
blocks.zh: 除了代表性外,我们通过现有VQA模型的两种确定性碎片抽样战略,展示了QRH的效用。 分布式保留采样(DPS)近似于原始随机采样者的QRH分数分配,不进行再培训,而质量意识采样(QAS)则优先考虑QRH分数高的区域,并配以微调. 这些策略允许QRH在保留原始片段布局和VQA架构的同时,指导区域选择.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are: • An explicit regional representation for VQA that separates localized degradation evidence from perceptual importance. • An interpretable, semantically guided construction of the regional representation without requiring pixel-level annotations. • Two QRH-guided sampling policies, with experiments demonstrating
stable prediction through DPS and performance gains through QAS adaptation.

blocks.en: 2.1 Hand-crafted and end-to-end VQA methods
blocks.zh: 2.1 手工制作和端到端的VQA方法

blocks.en:
Early quality assessment used distortion-specific features and natural scene
statistics, as in BRISQUE [ 6 ] ,
V-BLIINDS [ 7 ] , VIIDEO [ 8 ] ,
TLVQM [ 9 ] , and VIDEVAL [ 10 ] .
Learned methods instead combine visual and temporal features, including
VSFA [ 11 ] , BVQA [ 12 ] , and recurrent or
attention-based architectures [ 13 , 14 , 15 , 16 , 17 ] .
Patch-VQ estimates space-time quality maps before global aggregation [ 18 ] .
These developments expand representation capacity beyond hand-crafted cues,
but regional degradation and its perceptual importance are often encoded
within learned features rather than exposed as distinct components.

blocks.en:
Fragment-based methods reduce the cost of high-resolution VQA. FAST-VQA
and FasterVQA sample spatial or spatio-temporal fragments [ 1 , 19 ] ;
DOVER separates aesthetic and technical quality, using fragments in its
technical branch [ 2 ] . COVER combines technical, aesthetic, and semantic
quality [ 3 ] ; MaxVQA and CLIPVQA incorporate language-based
representations [ 20 , 21 ] ; and ModularBVQA uses a
modular prediction architecture [ 4 ] .
QRH complements these architectures by explicitly representing regional
degradation evidence and perceptual importance before quality prediction.

blocks.en: 2.2 Regional quality modeling
blocks.zh: 2.2 区域质量建模

blocks.en:
Regional approaches model localized degradation, quality-aware importance,
or perceptual priors. BPSQM predicts pixel-wise quality maps from
full-reference image quality assessment (IQA) similarity
maps [ 22 ] ; TOPIQ uses semantic guidance for distortion
localization [ 23 ] ; and ReLIQS estimates IQA-specific
importance for patch selection [ 24 ] .
Saliency models such as TASED-Net, UNISAL, and ViSAGE provide visual-attention
priors [ 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 ] .
Among saliency methods, SF-VQA uses saliency-guided sampling and
pooling [ 29 ] , while KVQ combines visual saliency and local
texture quality [ 5 ] . These approaches establish the value of
spatially non-uniform quality modeling, while differing in whether their
maps describe degradation, attention, or usefulness for prediction. Our emphasis is on explicitly separating
quality evidence from perceptual priors and combining them into an explicit pixel-level regional representation that integrates localized degradation evidence with perceptual priors.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en:
We propose an explicit regional representation for video quality assessment, instantiated as a Quality-Relevance Heatmap (QRH). Rather than directly decomposing subjective quality into regional contributions, QRH organizes two complementary sources of spatial information: quality
evidence , which captures localized degradation cues, and perceptual priors , which characterize where such evidence may be more perceptually important. The resulting pixel-level representation summarizes the spatial distribution of quality-relevant evidence and its perceptual importance within a video clip and is independent of any particular VQA architecture.
The following sections describe the representation, its semantically guided
construction, and its use in fragment sampling.
blocks.zh:
我们建议为视频质量评估提供明确的区域代表,即时说明为质量与相关热量(QRH)。 QRH没有将主观质量直接分解为区域贡献,而是组织两个互补的空间信息来源:质量
证据可以捕捉到局部退化的提示和感知性前兆,而感知性前兆是这种证据在概念上更为重要的特征。 由此产生的像素级表现总结了质量相关证据的空间分布及其在视频片段中的感知重要性,独立于任何特定的VQA架构.

blocks.en: 3.2 QRH construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 QRH建造

blocks.en: Direct pixel-level supervision for quality-relevant regional evidence is generally unavailable, as subjective VQA datasets typically provide a single quality score per video. We therefore construct QRH without pixel-level human annotations by combining localized quality evidence with perceptual priors , producing an explicit spatial representation for downstream quality assessment.
blocks.zh: 对质量相关区域证据的直接像素级监督一般是不存在的,因为主观VQA数据集通常每个视频提供单一的质量分数. 因此,我们通过将本地化质量证据和感知前科相结合,构建了没有像素级人类说明的QRH,为下游质量评估提供了明确的空间代表。

blocks.en:
The internally constructed cues separate response strength from reliability: severity measures the cue response, while a bounded gate suppresses signals caused by natural scene content or estimation errors,
such as low texture resembling blur or inaccurate flow producing temporal
residuals. Blocking responses instead compare boundary and neighboring

preserves severity differences across clips, avoiding the amplification of
weak responses by per-clip normalization. Together, these steps provide
calibrated cue maps with reduced sensitivity to unreliable responses.

blocks.en:
Different degradation types may occur separately or overlap within a region.
The fusion should retain strong individual evidence while allowing multiple
cues to contribute. We use soft-OR , a continuous analogue of logical
OR, to combine the calibrated degradation maps: H quality = 1 − ∏ i ∈ { app , temp , comp } ( 1 − w i ​ H i ) , H_{\mathrm{quality}}=1-\prod_{i\in\{\mathrm{app},\mathrm{temp},\mathrm{comp}\}}\left(1-w_{i}H_{i}\right), (2) where w i w_{i} are the adaptive weights in Eq. ( 1 ).
Intuitively, each factor represents the complement of one weighted cue
response. Subtracting their product from one allows any active degradation
cue to raise the aggregate response. This has the form of a probabilistic
union, but the cue responses are treated as bounded evidence strengths,
not calibrated probabilities of independent events.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced an explicit pixel-level regional representation for video quality assessment, instantiated as a Quality-Relevance Heatmap (QRH). QRH combines localized degradation evidence with perceptual priors under VLM-derived semantic guidance, without requiring pixel-level annotations. Its utility is demonstrated through two QRH-guided sampling strategies applied to DOVER: DPS closely approximates predictions averaged over repeated random sampling without retraining, while QAS with fine-tuning improves most evaluated benchmark metrics. These results support explicit regional representations as an interface between localized quality analysis and downstream quality assessment. Future work will examine other VQA backbones, explore learning such regional representations directly from videos while preserving the semantic structure of the current cue-based construction, and apply them to tasks beyond VQA that benefit from spatially localized quality information.
blocks.zh: 我们为视频质量评估引入了明确的像素级区域代表,即时作为质量-相关性热(QRH). QRH在VLM衍生语义指导下将局部降解证据与感知前兆结合,而不需要像素级说明. 它的效用通过适用于DOVI的两个QRH制导采样策略得到证明: DPS与反复随机抽样的平均预测非常接近,没有再培训,而经过微调的QAS则改进了大多数评价的基准度量。 这些结果支持将明确的区域代表性作为本地化质量分析和下游质量评估之间的接口。 今后的工作将审查其他VQA主干线,探索直接从视频中学习这种区域表现,同时保留当前基于提示的构造的语义结构,并将其应用于VQA以外从空间本地化质量信息中受益的任务.
